title: Project Atlas kickoff recap
body:
Hi team,

Thanks for joining the Project Atlas kickoff today. Quick recap:

- Goal: launch the new route-optimization engine for Lumen Freight by end of Q1.
- Joe Smith will own the backend architecture and the atlas-routing-engine repo.
- First milestone: working prototype of the dispatch API in 3 weeks.
- Weekly sync moves to Tuesdays at 10am.

Notes and the kickoff brief are in Notion under "Project Atlas - Kickoff Brief".

Thanks,
Abraham
